description: The HANA3 ASIC is a SAS-based, three-lifecycle, rotating media controller, the security portion of which containing HASH, AES, Entropy and Modular Arithmetic (ZMODP) hardware accelerators, along with DRBG and RSA hybrid (hardware/firmware) services. The DRBG is compliant with ANSI 9.31. RSA is compliant with PKCS #11.
